name: Neuralink
description: Brain-computer interface for paralysis, ALS, spinal cord injury. N1 implant with 1024 electrodes. First human (Noland Arbaugh) controls cursor with thoughts. PRIME Study ongoing.
investors: ARK Invest, DFJ Growth, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Thrive Capital, Peter Thiel

name: Synchron
description: Endovascular BCI — Stentrode implanted via jugular vein, no craniotomy. Motor intention decoding for paralysis. Total funding: $345M.
investors: ARCH Venture Partners, General Atlantic, Bezos Expeditions, Gates Frontier

name: Precision Neuroscience
description: Second-most funded BCI after Neuralink. Layer 7 Cortical Interface — ultra-thin film electrode array on brain surface, 1024 channels. Acute hospital setting first.
investors: Forepont Capital, Mubadala Capital, Draper Associates, Alumni Ventures

name: Paradromics
description: High-bandwidth BCI for speech restoration in locked-in patients. INFINITY device — 4096-channel neural recording. $87M additional round Feb 2025.
investors: NEOM Investment Fund (Saudi Arabia), Prime Movers Lab, Westcott

name: Blackrock Neurotech
description: Maker of NeuroPort Utah Array — the only BCI with 50+ humans implanted globally. Majority stake from Tether. 100+ patient years of implant data.

name: Motif Neurotech
description: Implantable BCI for treatment-resistant major depression. Targeted at 100M+ TRD patients globally. Subcallosal cingulate recording + stimulation.
investors: Arboretum Ventures, KdT Ventures, Santori Capital, Dolby Family Ventures

name: INBRAIN Neuroelectronics
description: Graphene-based BCI with 65,536 channels — orders of magnitude more than silicon. Ultra-low power consumption. Targeting epilepsy and brain tumor resection.

name: Subsense
description: Non-surgical brain-computer interface using advanced EEG + AI. Precision decoding of motor intentions. Emerged from stealth mid-2024.

name: NeuroPace
description: RNS System — first closed-loop responsive neurostimulation for drug-resistant epilepsy. Device tracks brain activity 24/7, delivers stimulation on demand. FDA approved 2013.

name: Neurable
description: BCI for both consumer (attention training, meditation) and research applications. Dry-electrode EEG headset. Royalty partnerships with major headset OEMs.

name: Forest Neurotech
description: Non-profit/ academic BCI initiative focused on whole-cortex recording. Cross-institution research consortium. Government funded.

name: Merge Labs
description: Consumer BCI platform for focus, meditation, and cognitive enhancement. Hardware + subscription app model.

name: SetPoint Medical
description: FDA-approved implanted VNS device for rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn's disease. First bioelectronic medicine approved for auto-immune disease. Abbott and Boston Scientific as strategic investors.
investors: Abbott, Boston Scientific, JOBS Act equity crowdfunding

name: Nalu Medical
description: Externalry powered micro-implant for chronic pain. Less than 1-inch footprint. Acquired by Boston Scientific for $533M total deal value.

name: Nervonik
description: Peripheral nerve stimulation system for chronic pain and inflammation. Non-invasive wearable device first, implantable in development.

name: Synergia Medical
description: NAOS — next-gen implantable VNS for drug-resistant epilepsy. Novel cuff electrode design reduces surgical risk. Belgium-based.

name: Mobia Medical
description: Vivistim Paired VNS — vagus nerve stimulation paired with rehabilitation therapy for stroke survivors. FDA breakthrough designation. IPO filing pending.

name: Pulsetto
description: Non-invasive VNS device for stress, anxiety, sleep. Wearable neck device. Consumer market focus. Lithuania-based.

name: Saluda Medical
description: Evoke — first closed-loop spinal cord stimulation system. Measures neural response in real-time and auto-adjusts stimulation. ASX listed. AU$231M IPO.

name: ONWARD Medical
description: ARC Therapy — transcutaneous and implantable spinal cord stimulation for paraplegics to regain leg movement. Non-traumatic SCI focus. SoftBank backed.

name: SPR Therapeutics
description: P PNS (peripheral nerve stimulation) for chronic pain. 60-day temporary lead. $25M equity + $60M debt. Backed by Cleveland Clinic.

name: ShiraTronics
description: Neuromodulation for chronic migraine. Externalry powered rechargeable implant. Series B led by a major strategic investor.

name: Amber Therapeutics
description: Muscle定向 neuromodulation for urinary incontinence and fecal incontinence. Novel approach targeting specific nerve branches. UK-based.

name: Cala Health
description: Wearable TMS for essential tremor and Parkinson's tremor. Cala Trio — externalry worn device. Consumer and clinical channels.

name: Presidio Medical
description: Non-charge-based waveform SCS system — novel mechanism avoids传统的charge balancing issues. Deerfield Management backed.

name: Cadence Neuroscience
description: Closed-loop SCS for drug-resistant epilepsy. FoundedMayo Clinic. Novel stimulation paradigm targeting seizure networks.
investors: Angelini Lumira, F-Prime Capital, LivaNova USA, Mayo Clinic

name: Beacon Biosignals
description: AI-driven EEG wearable for ICU monitoring and pharmaceutical drug trials. EEG data + ML to detect CNS adverse events. Takeda, GV backed.

name: NeuroFlow
description: Behavioral health platform integrating brain stimulation, cognitive training, and measurement. $2.8M NIH SBIR grant May 2025.

name: Neurotrack
description: AI-powered cognitive health platform for memory loss detection and prevention. Kiosk + app cognitive assessments. 6-minute memory test.
investors: Khosla Ventures, Racial Equity for AI Labs, Social Impact

name: Kernel
description: Full-brain helmet fNIRS + EEG neuroimaging for pharma trials and elite performance. $1.5M per unit. 20+ pharmaceutical clients. Most accurate in-class.
investors: General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, Delta-v Capital

name: Cognitize
description: Cognito Therapeutics — non-invasive gamma frequency stimulation for Alzheimer's. $73M raise for pivotal trial. Alzheimer's Drug Discovery Foundation backed.
investors: Alzheimer's Drug Discovery Foundation, Starbloom Capital, IAG Capital

name: Cerebrel
description: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback for mental health personalization. AI parses brain imaging to match patients to targeted therapies.
investors: a16z Bio + Health, First Round Capital

name: Neurent Medical
description: Neuromodulation device for chronic rhinitis (overactive nose). Nerva — non-surgical in-office procedure. Ireland-based.

name: NextSense
description: In-ear EEG Smartbuds for sleep monitoring and analysis. Real-time sleep staging, snoring detection, apnea alerts. First FDA-cleared in-ear EEG.

name: Cortexity
description: AI EEG interpretation for ICU and OR — real-time seizure detection, coma prognosis, sleep staging. FDA-cleared. Used in 200+ hospitals.

name: Axem Neurotechnology
description: Portable neuroimaging for neurorehabilitation. Headset + AI for stroke and TBI recovery monitoring. Canada-based academic spin-off.

name: Neura Health
description: Virtual neurology clinic for migraine and cognitive health. Insurance-based telehealth platform. 50+ neurologists in network.
investors: City Light Capital,初次天使投资人

name: Ceribell
description: Portable point-of-care EEG for seizure detection in ICUs and ERs. 6-minute setup. AI-powered seizure identification. 500+ hospitals.

name: Zeto
description: Wireless portable EEG headset + NeuroPulse AI for status epilepticus detection in hospitals. FDA cleared. Used in 100+ US hospitals.

name: Seer Medical
description: At-home EEG + video monitoring for seizure diagnosis. Australia-based, expanding to US. $7M revenue 2024. Breakthrough Victoria backed.

name: Epitel
description: Wearable EEG seizure detection system for epilepsy monitoring units and home use. REMI — FDA 510(k) cleared. NIH grant recipient.

name: Neuro Event Labs
description: Nelli — AI-powered seizure monitoring system. Finland-based. FDA 510(k) clearance December 2025. US market entry.

name: Neurava
description: Wearable seizure detection + SUDEP (sudden death) risk stratification. $4M NIH Blueprint Optimizer award for algorithm development.

name: Theta Neurotech
description: Wearable EEG system with 2-hour advance seizure warning. Non-invasive headset + AI prediction algorithm. Vaark Ventures backed.

name: Epihunter
description: AI-powered seizure detection app for children with absence epilepsy. Uses smartwatch + smartphone. $200K Epilepsy Foundation grant.

name: Empatica
description: FDA-cleared EmbracePlus smartwatch for seizure alerting. Deployable in pharma trials. Awarded major US government decentralized research contract.

name: Brainscope
description: EEG-based traumatic brain injury (TBI) assessment device for military and emergency use. Handheld, battlefield-ready. $62M total raised.

name: NeuroPace RNS System
description: FDA approves RNS System — first closed-loop responsive neurostimulation device for epilepsy. Device tracks brain activity 24/7, delivers stimulation on demand.

name: DARPA SyNAPSE
description: DARPA-funded IBM True North chip — 1M neurons, 100B synapses, 4k pixels. First large-scale neuromorphic processor. Scaled neuroscience simulation.

name: Neuralink First Human
description: First human (Noland Arbaugh) implanted with N1 chip — quadriplegic controls computer cursor with thoughts. 1024-channel recording. Live stream demonstrations.

name: Boston Scientific Nalu
description: Boston Scientific acquires Nalu Medical for $533M — adds externalry powered neurostimulation platform to its chronic pain portfolio.
